applicant.name: Dr. Sophie Lechner
applicant.organisation: Danube Institute for Diabetes Research (university research group)

request.purpose: Scientific research on the epidemiology of chronic diseases to inform prevention programmes.
request.question: How many patients with chronic pain take paracetamol, by hospital?
definitions: Paracetamol = ATC code starting with N02BE.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per hospital: patients with an active paracetamol.
